declare

Trigger.Name: KEY_NEXT_ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chk boolean;
 x varchar2(1);
begin
 begin
 select 'x' into x
 from fixed_sites 
 where site_id = :ctrl_block2.site_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select 'X' into x 
 from fixed_sites
 where location_name like :ctrl_block2.site_id||'%';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk := show_lov('lov_sites');
 when too_many_rows then
 chk := show_lov('lov_sites');
 end;
 when too_many_rows then
 chk := show_lov('lov_sites');
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
next_item;
end;

begin

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK2_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block2_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
/* if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.WEEK_DATE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.week_date',action);
 end if;
*/
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.LAST_NAME' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.last_name',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.SITE_ID' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.site_id',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.STATUS' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.status',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.PROCEDURE_CODE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.procedure_code',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.START_DATE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.start_date',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK2.END_DATE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block2.end_date',action);
 end if;

 if action = 'E' then
 --set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_lov_sites',ENABLED,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_status',ENABLED,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_procedure_code',ENABLED,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,property_true);
 else
 -- set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_lov_sites',ENABLED,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_status',ENABLED,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_procedure_code',ENABLED,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block2.pb_retrieve',ENABLED,property_false);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data2 IS
 q_str varchar2(500);
 lov_lmt varchar2(10);
 q_hits number;
begin
 q_str := 'chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id ';
 if :parameter.p_donor_id is null then 
 if :ctrl_block2.last_name is not null then
 q_str :=q_str||' and ( upper(last_name) like ''%'||:ctrl_block2.last_name||'%'' ';
 q_str :=q_str||' or upper(first_name) like ''%'||:ctrl_block2.last_name||'%'' ';
 q_str :=q_str||' or soundex(last_name) = soundex(:ctrl_block2.last_name) ';
 q_str :=q_str||' or soundex(first_name) = soundex(:ctrl_block2.last_name)) ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block2.site_id is not null then
 q_str := q_str||' and site_id = :ctrl_block2.site_id ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block2.status is not null then
 q_str := q_str||' and status = :ctrl_block2.status ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block2.procedure_code is not null then
 q_str := q_str||' and proc_code = :ctrl_block2.procedure_code ';
 end if;
 if (:ctrl_block2.start_date is not null or 
 :ctrl_block2.end_date is not null ) 
 then
 if :ctrl_block2.start_date is not null and
 :ctrl_block2.end_date is not null 
 then
 q_str := q_str||' and sch_date between :ctrl_block2.start_date and :ctrl_block2.end_date ';
 elsif :ctrl_block2.start_date is not null and
 :ctrl_block2.end_date is null 
 then
 q_str := q_str||' and sch_date >= :ctrl_block2.start_date ';
 elsif :ctrl_block2.start_date is null and
 :ctrl_block2.end_date is not null 
 then
 q_str := q_str||' and sch_date <= :ctrl_block2.end_date ';
 end if;
 else 
 begin
 select parameter_value
 into lov_lmt
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'LOV_LIMIT'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 lov_lmt := '21';
 end;
 q_str := q_str||' and sch_date between sysdate and sysdate + '||lov_lmt||' '; 
 :ctrl_block2.start_date := sysdate;
 :ctrl_block2.end_date := sysdate + lov_lmt;
 end if;
 else
 q_str := q_str || ' and donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id '; 
 end if; 
 :ctrl_block2.query_str := q_str;
 -- message(q_str);pause;
 set_block_property('donor_schedule',DEFAULT_WHERE,q_str);
 set_block_property('donor_schedule',ORDER_BY,'SCH_DATE');
 go_block('donor_schedule');
 execute_query;
 q_hits := get_block_property('donor_schedule',query_hits);
 if q_hits > 0 then 
 set_control_block2_items('D');
 set_sort_buttons('E');
 else
 go_item('ctrl_block2.last_name');
 show_error('9188');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
